caseName: Public Service Commission v. Chesapeake & Potomac Telephone Co.
caseNameFull: Public Service Commission of Maryland v. Chesapeake & Potomac Telephone Company of Maryland

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 84-871, Louisiana Public Service Commission v. FCC; No. 84-889, California v. FCC; No. 84-1054, Public Utilities Commission of Ohio v. FCC; and No. 84-1069, Florida

Public Service Commission v. FCC, supra.

Justice Powell and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this order.
